assertions: The querent shall obtain the office/preferment he seeks: the Moon, placed in the tenth house (the office), applies to a trine of Saturn, and Saturn — exalted in the Ascendant — receives Venus (significator of the querent) and is received by her again; mutual reception with application perfects the matter
The preferment comes through a grave, Saturnine patron or authority (the exalted Saturn who receives the querent), not through the solar friend he relies on

The pretended friend will hinder rather than help: the Sun, lord of the eleventh, stands in the seventh in opposition to the Ascendant and joined to the Dragon's Tail — an open opponent under the guise of friendship, to be distrusted
Attainment is not immediate or clean: the Moon separates from a square of Mercury and the perfection is by application to slow Saturn, so expect delay and negotiation before possession
method: Horary astrology (Lilly, Christian Astrology Book II): Ascendant/Venus for querent, tenth house for the office, Moon's applications and receptions for perfection
reasoning: Significators per Lilly's prose: querent = Ascendant and its associate Venus; office = tenth house; Moon in the tenth already joins the querent's cause to the office's house. Perfection route: Moon applies to trine of Saturn; Saturn is exalted in the Ascendant and in mutual reception with Venus (he receives Venus, she receives him), the classic testimony that the matter is brought to pass through the Saturnian party, with the fourth-house lordship of Saturn pointing to a successful end of the matter. Obstruction testimony weighed and subordinated: Sun lord of the eleventh (pretended friend) in the seventh opposing the Ascendant with Cauda Draconis shows the friend is really an adversary and will oppose, but he makes no application that forbids the Moon–Saturn perfection, so he delays/embarrasses rather than prevents. Moon separating from Mercury's square marks recent impediment or ill news already passing. End-of-matter (Saturn as lord of the fourth, exalted and receiving) supports a good conclusion. Direction is therefore positive with delay; no mixed verdict, as the perfection testimony outweighs the prohibition testimony.
summary: He shall attain the preferment, through a Saturnine patron and after delay, despite a false friend's opposition
timing: Window: horary scale of weeks to a few months while the Moon's application to Saturn perfects; main coordinate: the completion (perfection) of the Moon's trine to Saturn, at which point the grant of the office is made — no exact calendar date is judged from the figure as given
